mui — Material UI Component Library for SAX

Zig 0.17This plugin is built with Zig 0.17: the 0.17 branch builds with Zig 0.17 and passes the Zig unit tests; the old 0.14.1 branch is kept unchanged.

sa_plugin_mui is an SA/SAX Material UI component library aimed at sa_plugin_react. The implementation direction is SA-first: the component bodies are SAX source assets, and the Zig part only handles the plugin descriptor and share asset installation; it does no component behavior, theme logic, class-name generation, or CLI commands.

Basic facts

  • Capability segment: mui; dependency: react (required, path ../sa_plugin_react).
  • Permissions: read-only access to the project directory; no network, no child processes.
  • It has no CLI commands of its own; all builds go through sa react ... or sa vite ....
  • Core assets: mui/material.sax (component source, with the v1 manifest locked to the @mui/material default exports), mui/icons_material.sax (icon wrappers), mui/material_kit_layout.sax / mui/material_kit_views.sax.

How to enable it

MUI components are consumed through the generic component-source composition path of React/SAX (--include):

# 编译期检查
SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 \
SA_PLUGINS_PATH=.../libreact.so:.../libmui.so \
  sa react check demos/mui_all_components_from_library.sax \
    --include mui/material.sax --include mui/icons_material.sax

# 开发热重载（推荐）
sa vite dev demos/mui_dashboard.sax --react --include mui/material.sax \
  --out-dir .zig-cache/mui-dashboard-dev --port 5173 --title "SA MUI Dashboard"

Components can declare slot projection context defaults with <Slot contextProps="..." [contextScope="descendants"] />; ThemeProvider/CssVarsProvider use descendant scope so theme defaults cross transparent wrapper components.

NoteThe upstream material-ui repository serves only as a React model reference, not a runtime dependency; this plugin does not call npm, Node MUI, React DOM, or Emotion.

Status boundaries

  • Lab components (LoadingButton, Timeline, Masonry, TabContext/TabList/TabPanel, SimpleTreeView/TreeItem, the SpeedDial family) already have SAX implementations; the icon set covers dashboard navigation and Material Kit-adjacent actions.
  • className support is incremental: common root-slot components merge the incoming root className with the generated utility classes.
  • Dynamic object prop values, custom slot component replacement, styled-engine overrides, theme styleOverrides, transition orchestration, portals, focus traps, and the like are still future work.
  • Large MUI demos have a heavy compile-time memory cost (a full all-components build on an 8 GiB host may be OOM-killed); for regression verification, use the focused target demos/mui_theme_lab_smoke.sax, and use --mem-report when investigating.
NoteEvery MUI demo has a same-named _sla.sax SLA handler variant; components using SLA handlers rely on SAX to clean up state at destroy time, with no need for explicit release lines. For component syntax and theme details, see the "SAX / MUI UI Development" chapter.
